To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the change in the spoken discourse of students is mainly due to the increase in the use of the activity-based language, which is a form of scientific discourse, 2) students use the background category to a lesser degree, 3) the change in language is not due to the increase or decrease in the use of any specific word, but the change is mainly due to using different categories, 4) students use more activity-based language in the later stages of the class, and

the topic model we used was able to identify the change in the spoken languages of students in science classrooms and the root of the language change was found to be the increase in the use of activity-based language.
the topic model is effective in identifying the root cause of language evolution and that it can be applied to other domains.

the analysis of the language evolution of students over time in a science class.
analyzing the evolution of a language in a science classroom and discovering the root of this change.
